questions.question: Which film series features the line "May the Force be with you"?
questions.fact: The line first appeared in the original 1977 film. 4 May is now "Star Wars Day", as in "May the Fourth be with you".

questions.question: In "Friends", what is the name of the coffee shop?
questions.fact: The famous orange sofa in Central Perk was reportedly found in a storage room at the Warner Bros. studio.

questions.question: Which animated film has a snowman called Olaf?
questions.fact: Frozen's "Let It Go" won the Oscar for Best Original Song, and Frozen was the highest-grossing animated film of its time.

questions.question: Who played Jack in "Titanic" (1997)?
questions.fact: DiCaprio finally won his first acting Oscar in 2016, for "The Revenant", after several earlier nominations.

questions.question: What is the name of the wizarding school in Harry Potter?
questions.fact: Hogwarts' motto is "Draco dormiens nunquam titillandus": never tickle a sleeping dragon.

questions.question: In "The Lion King", what is Simba's father called?
questions.fact: James Earl Jones voiced Mufasa in both the 1994 and 2019 films. He was also the voice of Darth Vader.

questions.question: Which TV series is set on the continent of Westeros?
questions.fact: Many Game of Thrones scenes were filmed in Spain, including Seville's Alcázar, Girona and San Juan de Gaztelugatxe.

questions.question: Which colour pill does Neo take in "The Matrix"?
questions.fact: "Red pill or blue pill" became a famous way of saying: face the hard truth, or stay comfortable. The Matrix came out in 1999.

questions.question: In "Breaking Bad", what subject does Walter White teach?
questions.fact: Bryan Cranston won four Emmys for playing Walter White. The show was filmed in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

questions.question: Which film series follows Dominic Toretto and his "family"?
questions.fact: The first film, "The Fast and the Furious", came out in 2001, with Vin Diesel as Dom.

questions.question: What is the name of the cowboy toy in "Toy Story"?
questions.fact: Tom Hanks voices Woody in English. Toy Story (1995) was the first full-length film made entirely with computer animation.

questions.question: In "Stranger Things", what is the name of the girl with special powers?
questions.fact: Millie Bobby Brown shaved her head to play Eleven. The show is set in the made-up town of Hawkins, Indiana.

questions.question: Who sings "My Heart Will Go On" from "Titanic"?
questions.fact: Céline Dion is from Quebec, Canada. "My Heart Will Go On" won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.question: Which superhero is Tony Stark?
questions.fact: Robert Downey Jr. played Iron Man in the very first Marvel Cinematic Universe film, back in 2008.

questions.question: In the US version of "The Office", which company do the characters work for?
questions.fact: The US Office is a remake of the British original by Ricky Gervais, set at the paper company Wernham Hogg.

questions.question: What kind of creature is Shrek?
questions.fact: Shrek won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature, in 2002.

questions.question: Which Spanish series is about a heist on the Royal Mint of Spain?
questions.fact: "La casa de papel" first aired on Spain's Antena 3 in 2017, then became a worldwide hit on Netflix as "Money Heist".

questions.question: In "Finding Nemo", what kind of fish is Nemo?
questions.fact: In real life, clownfish can change from male to female, and they live safely among stinging sea anemones.

questions.question: Who directed "Jurassic Park" (1993)?
questions.fact: Spielberg also directed "Jaws", "E.T." and the Indiana Jones films. Jurassic Park mixed computer effects with giant animatronic dinosaurs.

questions.question: How many Infinity Stones are there in the Marvel films?
questions.fact: The six Infinity Stones are Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time and Soul. Thanos collects them in "Avengers: Infinity War".

questions.question: Which Spanish director made "Volver" and "All About My Mother"?
questions.fact: Almodóvar has won two Oscars: for "All About My Mother" and for the screenplay of "Talk to Her".

questions.question: Which South Korean film was the first non-English-language winner of the Best Picture Oscar?
questions.fact: Bong Joon-ho's "Parasite" won four Oscars in 2020, including Best Picture and Best Director.

questions.question: In "Squid Game", which children's game is played first?
questions.fact: Squid Game became one of Netflix's most-watched series ever after its 2021 release.

questions.question: Who is Harry Potter's red-haired best friend?
questions.fact: Rupert Grint played Ron in all eight Harry Potter films.

questions.question: Which film features a giant shark attacking Amity Island?
questions.fact: The mechanical shark kept breaking down, so Spielberg showed it less, which made the film scarier. The crew called it "Bruce".

questions.question: What is the name of Batman's butler?
questions.fact: His full name is Alfred Pennyworth. Michael Caine played him in Christopher Nolan's Batman films.

questions.question: "Grey's Anatomy" is mainly set in which city?
questions.fact: Grey's Anatomy has been on air since 2005, one of the longest-running prime-time medical dramas in US TV history.

questions.question: Which Pixar film is about a rat who dreams of being a chef in Paris?
questions.fact: Pixar's team took cooking classes and visited top Paris restaurants. Ratatouille itself is a vegetable stew from Provence.

questions.question: Who played the Joker in "The Dark Knight" (2008)?
questions.fact: Heath Ledger won a posthumous Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for the role.

questions.question: In "The Simpsons", what is the name of the bar Homer goes to?
questions.fact: The Simpsons is the longest-running American animated series, on air since 1989.

questions.question: Which film has the famous line "I'll be back"?
questions.fact: Arnold Schwarzenegger reportedly wanted to say "I will be back". It became one of the most quoted lines in film.

questions.question: In the film "The Wizard of Oz", what colour are Dorothy's magic slippers?
questions.fact: In the original book the slippers are silver. The film made them ruby red to show off its new Technicolor.

questions.question: Which actor was stranded on an island with a volleyball called Wilson in "Cast Away"?
questions.fact: Filming of "Cast Away" paused for about a year so Tom Hanks could lose around 25 kg for the island scenes.

questions.question: "Life is like a box of chocolates" is a line from which film?
questions.fact: Tom Hanks won Best Actor for Forrest Gump, his second Oscar in a row after "Philadelphia".

questions.question: Which film has the line "Here's looking at you, kid"?
questions.fact: Casablanca won Best Picture. Famously, the line "Play it again, Sam" is never actually said in the film.

questions.question: Which hobbit carries the One Ring to Mordor?
questions.fact: Elijah Wood played Frodo. The Lord of the Rings trilogy was filmed in New Zealand.

questions.question: Which actor plays Captain Jack Sparrow?
questions.fact: Johnny Depp based Jack Sparrow partly on Keith Richards, who later appeared as Jack's father.

questions.question: In "Back to the Future", which car is the time machine?
questions.fact: The DeLorean DMC-12 was built in Northern Ireland, with a stainless steel body and gull-wing doors.

questions.question: How fast must the DeLorean go to travel in time?
questions.fact: 88 miles per hour is about 141 km/h.

questions.question: Which TV series follows the Shelby family gang in Birmingham?
questions.fact: Peaky Blinders is set in 1920s Birmingham. A real gang of that name existed around 1900.

questions.question: In "Friends", what is the name of Ross's pet monkey?
questions.fact: Marcel was played by a capuchin monkey called Katie.

questions.question: "The Crown" is about which royal family?
questions.fact: The Crown covers Queen Elizabeth II's reign over six seasons, with three different actresses playing her.

questions.question: Which Netflix series goes behind the scenes of Formula 1?
questions.fact: Drive to Survive is widely credited with bringing lots of new fans to Formula 1, especially in the USA.

questions.question: Who directed "Titanic" and "Avatar"?
questions.fact: James Cameron also made the Terminator films, and in 2012 he dived alone to the bottom of the Mariana Trench.

questions.question: Which film is the highest-grossing of all time?
questions.fact: Avatar has made about $2.9 billion worldwide. It's set on Pandora, a moon full of glowing jungle.

questions.question: Which director made "Inception" and "Oppenheimer"?
questions.fact: Nolan avoids computer effects when he can: the atomic test in "Oppenheimer" was recreated with real practical effects.

questions.question: Which film won the Oscar for Best Picture in 2024?
questions.fact: Oppenheimer won seven Oscars, including Best Director for Christopher Nolan and Best Actor for Cillian Murphy.

questions.question: Who played Barbie in the 2023 film?
questions.fact: Greta Gerwig's "Barbie" was the highest-grossing film of 2023 worldwide.

questions.question: Which Spanish actor won an Oscar for "No Country for Old Men"?
questions.fact: Javier Bardem was the first Spanish actor to win an Oscar, in 2008. He is married to Penélope Cruz.

questions.question: Which Spanish actress won an Oscar for "Vicky Cristina Barcelona"?
questions.fact: Penélope Cruz won Best Supporting Actress in 2009, the first Spanish actress ever to win an Oscar.

questions.question: Which Spanish actor is the voice of Puss in Boots?
questions.fact: Antonio Banderas is from Málaga. Puss in Boots got his own films in 2011 and 2022.

questions.question: Which Chilean-born actor plays Joel in the series "The Last of Us"?
questions.fact: Pedro Pascal was born in Santiago, Chile, and also starred in "The Mandalorian" and "Narcos".

questions.question: Which Netflix series is set in an elite private school in Spain?
questions.fact: Élite premiered in 2018 and is set at the fictional school Las Encinas.

questions.question: In "Game of Thrones", what is the name of Jon Snow's direwolf?
questions.fact: Ghost is an albino direwolf, white with red eyes, and the quietest of the Stark pups.

questions.question: In "Harry Potter", which Quidditch position does Harry play?
questions.fact: The Seeker has to catch the Golden Snitch, which is worth 150 points and ends the match.

questions.question: Which actor plays Neo in "The Matrix"?
questions.fact: Keanu Reeves was born in Beirut. He trained in martial arts for months to do many of his own fight scenes.

questions.question: Which superhero comes from the planet Krypton?
questions.fact: Superman first appeared in comics in 1938. His Kryptonian name is Kal-El.

questions.question: What is Spider-Man's real name in most films?
questions.fact: Spider-Man was created in 1962 by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko. Peter Parker gets his powers from a spider bite.

questions.question: What is Batman's real name?
questions.fact: Batman first appeared in 1939. Bruce Wayne lives in Wayne Manor, near Gotham City.

questions.question: In "Home Alone", where is the family flying when they forget Kevin?
questions.fact: Home Alone (1990) is one of the highest-grossing live-action comedies of all time.

questions.question: What is the name of the hotel in "The Shining"?
questions.fact: The Overlook was inspired by the Stanley Hotel in Colorado, where Stephen King stayed and got the idea for the story.

questions.question: What is Sheldon's catchphrase in "The Big Bang Theory"?
questions.fact: "Bazinga!" was reportedly suggested by one of the writers, who used to say it after playing pranks.

questions.question: "How you doin'?" is Joey's catchphrase in which show?
questions.fact: Friends ran for 10 seasons, from 1994 to 2004.

questions.question: What is the bar called in "How I Met Your Mother"?
questions.fact: MacLaren's was inspired by a real New York pub called McGee's.

questions.question: In "Squid Game", what colour are the guards' jumpsuits?
questions.fact: The guards' masks show a circle, triangle or square to mark their rank.

questions.question: Which film series follows the spy Ethan Hunt?
questions.fact: Tom Cruise does many of his own stunts as Ethan Hunt, including climbing the outside of the Burj Khalifa.

questions.question: Which actor played James Bond in the most official films?
questions.fact: Roger Moore played Bond seven times, from 1973 to 1985. Sean Connery played him six times in the official series.

questions.question: What is James Bond's code number?
questions.fact: "Double-O" means a licence to kill. Bond's creator, Ian Fleming, worked in naval intelligence during World War II.

questions.question: In which film does a boy say "I see dead people"?
questions.fact: The Sixth Sense (1999) was directed by M. Night Shyamalan and is famous for its twist ending.

questions.question: Which Spanish director made "The Others" starring Nicole Kidman?
questions.fact: Amenábar also won an Oscar for "The Sea Inside" (Mar adentro), starring Javier Bardem.

questions.question: Which Spanish director made "The Impossible", about the 2004 tsunami?
questions.fact: The Impossible is based on the true story of a Spanish family who survived the tsunami in Thailand.

questions.question: Which series follows the Dutton family's ranch in Montana?
questions.fact: Yellowstone stars Kevin Costner as the rancher John Dutton.

questions.question: Which series is about the Roy family and their media empire?
questions.fact: Succession won the Emmy for Outstanding Drama Series three times.

questions.question: In Spain it's called "Gran Hermano". What is the original name of this reality show?
questions.fact: Big Brother first aired in the Netherlands in 1999. Its name comes from George Orwell's novel "1984".

questions.question: Which cooking contest in Spain has judges Jordi Cruz, Pepe Rodríguez and Samantha Vallejo-Nágera?
questions.fact: MasterChef started in the UK in 1990. The Spanish version began on TVE in 2013.

questions.question: Which film features the cannibal Hannibal Lecter?
questions.fact: Anthony Hopkins won Best Actor as Hannibal Lecter despite being on screen for only about 16 minutes.

questions.question: In "Pulp Fiction", what is a "Royale with Cheese"?
questions.fact: France uses the metric system, so a "quarter pounder" there is a "Royale with Cheese", as Vincent explains.

questions.question: Which actor plays Wolverine in the X-Men films?
questions.fact: Hugh Jackman holds a Guinness World Record for the longest career as a live-action Marvel superhero.

questions.question: Which actor plays Deadpool?
questions.fact: Ryan Reynolds is Canadian. "Deadpool & Wolverine" (2024) became the highest-grossing R-rated film ever.

questions.question: Which film's tagline was "In space no one can hear you scream"?
questions.fact: Alien (1979) was directed by Ridley Scott, with Sigourney Weaver as Ripley.

questions.question: Who played Rose in "Titanic"?
questions.fact: Kate Winslet and Leonardo DiCaprio stayed close friends and starred together again in "Revolutionary Road".

questions.question: The songs in "Mamma Mia!" are by which band?
questions.fact: The musical is named after ABBA's 1975 hit. It opened in London in 1999.

questions.question: Which 2016 musical is about a jazz pianist and an actress in Los Angeles?
questions.fact: La La Land won six Oscars, and was famously announced as Best Picture by mistake. The real winner was "Moonlight".

questions.question: Which film tells the story of Queen and Freddie Mercury?
questions.fact: Rami Malek won the Best Actor Oscar for playing Freddie Mercury.

questions.question: What does E.T. famously want to do?
questions.fact: E.T. (1982) became the highest-grossing film ever until "Jurassic Park" overtook it in 1993.

questions.question: Which Star Wars character says "Do or do not. There is no try"?
questions.fact: In the original trilogy, Yoda was a puppet performed and voiced by Frank Oz, who also performed Miss Piggy.

questions.question: Who is Luke Skywalker's father?
questions.fact: The famous line is "No, I am your father". People often misquote it as "Luke, I am your father".

questions.question: Which prequel series is about House Targaryen?
questions.fact: House of the Dragon is set almost 200 years before the events of Game of Thrones.

questions.question: Which giant ape climbs the Empire State Building?
questions.fact: The original King Kong came out in 1933.

questions.question: Which series follows the lawyer Saul Goodman?
questions.fact: Better Call Saul is a prequel to Breaking Bad, with Bob Odenkirk as the lawyer Saul Goodman.

questions.question: Which detective lives at 221B Baker Street?
questions.fact: 221B Baker Street is in London, and today there is a Sherlock Holmes Museum there.
